name: miniapp-packguard
description: Dependency-free package, asset, duplicate, collision, and regression auditing for mini apps.

scripts.test: node --test tests/audit.test.mjs tests/baseline.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/glob.test.mjs tests/reporters.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: node bin/miniapp-packguard.mjs audit --project-root examples/demo --config miniapp-packguard.config.json --format console
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run pack:check && npm run pack:test

author: MasterRook1e
